filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos. For English, top-tier educators like Abdul Bari and Neso Academy were chosen for their clarity and high view counts. For Arabic, selections were made from strong competitive programming channels and general educators. Two Arabic topics, 'Warshall's Algorithm' and 'Optimal Binary Search Trees', had very limited options, requiring the use of the view count exception rule to ensure coverage with the best available candidates.
